preview.boundary: Production fillDeepList and detail/highlight/group renderers only. Read-only explicit original-contract mock supplies stable 33 native tools, 38 cities, player king, current complete kind-4 menu DTO and incomplete five-property default goods DTO. Twelve rows include a long full name and equal names with distinct IDs. Fixture changes two tool values and then goods.custom, preserving menu owner and never clearing deepSig. PC route is goods0/赏赐; 844 mobile goods-person0/赏赐; 667 mobile person-goods1/没收. Only private mobileHost isAvailable capability assignment is added. Lifecycle/configure/start/bind, actual bridge/LIB/WASM/storage/save/gameplay/physical devices are excluded.
preview.processBoundary: Exactly one owned Chrome context/profile and one private ephemeral allowlist HTTP server; only owned pages/context/server closed. No existing browser/game/CDP/8080/process inventory accessed.
